programme.desc: Stan se convierte en entrenador de un equipo de hockey y trata de hacerlos ganadores. Mientras tanto, su padre tiene que lidiar con el recuerdo de una presentación de Stan en un partido de años atrás.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La ''Tía Regla'' de Stan le regala un pez dorado que le da mucho miedo y comienzan a haber asesinatos que la mamá de Stan trata de encubrir. Mientras tanto, Cartman se comporta muy extraño de repente y tiene barba.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los residentes de South Park se despiertan sin internet. Randy se entera de que en California todavía hay internet, por lo tanto, junto a su familia deciden viajar al oeste del país.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Ya que Butters parece encajar tan bien con Cartman, Kyle y Stan, sus padres deciden ir todos juntos a Aspen en un tiempo compartido.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: En Navidad, Stan se encuentra con unos animalitos del bosque que le piden favores aparentemente inocentes. Después de embarcarse en una aventura para ayudarlos, Stan descubre que ellos tienen un plan para traer al mundo al anticristo.
programme.sub-title: La Navidad de Las Criaturas del Bosque

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Varios habitantes de South Park explotan sin razón aparente y Randy es el encargado de descubrir por qué. Por otro lado, los chicos tienen que representar las "Estaciones de la cruz" en misa, y Kyle trata de ''conseguir una erección''.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cuando un chico mormón se muda a South Park, Stan tiene que patear su trasero, mientras el resto de los ciudadanos están fascinados y se convierten en mormones.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Un extraterrestre fugitivo pone en riesgo al planeta, Randy y Stan son responsables.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los adultos de la ciudad están obsesionados con los programas de homicidios de la tv, por lo cual los niños deciden bloquear esos canales.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan y Cartman chocan contra una represa de castores e inundan un pueblo cercano. Como resultado, la ciudad de South Park es declarada en estado de emergencia, ya que todo el mundo piensa que es obra del calentamiento global.
programme.sub-title: Dos días antes de pasado mañana

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan cumple 10 años y comienza a ver todo de una forma diferente. Para él, ahora todo es una mierda. Los otros chicos lo ven depresivo y se alejan de él para no ser contagiados.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La vida de Stan es un caos en su casa y en la escuela, y tiene que solucionarlo todo por sí mismo. Mientras tanto, el matrimonio Marsh pende de un hilo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan se vuelve adicto al nuevo juego móvil de Terrance y Phillip intenta convencer a sus amigos de que es el mejor juego de todos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Al ver a un chico con el síndrome de Tourette en una juguetería, Cartman se obsesiona con el tema y se percata de que puede decir lo que quiera sin consecuencias, por lo que se aprovecha de eso.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: South Park es invadido por hippies y Cartman trata de eliminarlos, tratándolos como si fueran una plaga. Mientras tanto, los hippies les están "lavando el cerebro" a Kyle, Stan y Kenny. Cartman es ahora la única esperanza.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se infiltra en la Agencia de Seguridad Nacional porque cree que lo están espiando, y no le gusta lo que encuentra en su expediente personal.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Para vengarse de la profesora de arte, los chicos cubren su casa con papel higiénico. Cartman considera matar a Kyle para que él no los delate.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: A Cartman no le queda otra que admitir que esta gordo, pero en lugar de hacer dieta para bajar de peso comienza a movilizarse en un scooter.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Toda su vida, el sueño de Cartman ha sido ser piloto de NASCAR y está dispuesto a hacer todo lo posible para que esto ocurra.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los niños roban dientes a los niños menos afortunados y los venden al hada de los dientes.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman le cuenta a sus amigos sobre un extraño sueño que tuvo en donde unos ''visitantes'' lo abducen y le ponen una sonda anal. Pero al parecer, no fue sólo un sueño, ya que algo está desollando a las vacas del pequeño pueblo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El restaurante favorito de Cartman ha cerrado y ha sido reemplazado por una tienda que vende marihuana medicinal.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos van de excursión al planetario y un empleado les lava el cerebro con efectos visuales para que quieran volver allí. Mientras, Cartman sólo se preocupa por ganar un casting para salir en el nuevo comercial de “Quesitos Poofs”.
programme.sub-title: Roger Ebert debería dejar las comidas engordantes

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman siente curiosidad de saber quién es su padre, pero averiguarlo no es una tarea fácil debido a que su madre se acostó con muchos hombres.
programme.sub-title: La mamá de Cartman es una puta sucia

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El Sr. Mackey es despedido de la escuela por perder una hoja de marihuana durante una presentación en contra de las drogas. Entretanto, los chicos tratan de salvar a Ike de su fiesta ''bris'' en donde le harán la circuncisión.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cuando la mamá de Cartman se da cuenta que ya no puede controlarlo busca ayuda de un experto. César Millan, el "susurrador de perros", acepta el reto pero Cartman no cederá sin antes pelear.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman cree que está muerto porque nadie responde a sus acciones. Se da cuenta que está atorado en la Tierra por sus fechorías, por lo que trata de hacer el bien dando regalos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se congela a sí mismo, despertando 500 años en el futuro cuando hay nutrias agresivas y lo peor de todo: ¡No hay Nintendo Wii! ¿Podrá Cartman escapar de ese crudo futuro?

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Durante una recreación sobre la guerra civil americana, Cartman lidera al ejército de los confederados para atacar a los guerreros de la Unión al otro lado de América para poder ganar una apuesta a Kyle y Stan.
programme.sub-title: La insignia roja de la homosexualidad

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Continuación de ''La mamá de Cartman es una puta sucia'', en el que Cartman quiere averiguar quién es su padre. Con la ayuda de Chef, los chicos tienen que salvar al Doctor Mephesto luego de recibir un disparo.
programme.sub-title: La madre de Cartman es aún una sucia perra

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos son desafiados por un grupo de jóvenes bailarines de breakdance, y Stan decide armar un grupo de baile para ganarles.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman sufre un fuerte golpe en la cabeza después de una caída casi fatal. La policía local asume que ahora Cartman tiene poderes psíquicos y lo contratan para resolver casos extraordinarios.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Al Gore visita South Park e intenta convencer a Stan, Kyle, Cartman y Kenny para salir a cazar al peligroso hombre-oso-cerdo. Al ayudarlo, los chicos se quedan atrapados en una cueva y mientras tratan de salir, Cartman descubre un tesoro.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Jimmy y Timmy entrenan para participar en las Olimpiadas Especiales y Jimmy acepta esteroides que le ofrece Nathan. Mientras, Cartman se disfraza para convencer a un comité calificado de que él es discapacitado y así ganar el premio.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Mientras la señora Garrison está tratando de encontrar una forma de convertirse en el hombre que siempre intentó ser, Cartman es puesto a cargo del salón de clases.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman ha sido diagnosticado con ansiedad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman hereda de su abuela un millón de dólares y se compra un parque de diversiones para él solo, al cual nadie más puede entrar (en especial Stan y Kyle).

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El sueño de Cartman de ser un pirata se convierte en realidad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La verdadera "Jenny from the block" se enfurece cuando una de las partes del cuerpo de Cartman se hace demasiado famosa por sus propios medios.
programme.sub-title: Culo gordo y cabeza de panqueuqe

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cuento Southparkitero del libro "Grandes Esperanzas" de Dickens, teniendo como protagonista a Pip, un inglés de clase pobre, y con Malcolm McDowell, un británico como narrador.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se convierte en un superhéroe llamado "El Mapache", pero aparece “Mysterion” y opaca la atención de todos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman llega a los mejores lugares de las listas de éxitos con su propia banda cristiana de rock, y los chicos son arrestados por bajar música de internet.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: En la primaria de South Park realizan una medición para ver el crecimiento corporal de los niños, pero Cartman confunde todo y se enfurece.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se disfraza de robot y le hace creer a Butters que es enviado desde Japón. Pero su broma se termina cuando descubre que Butters tiene un vídeo de él disfrazado de Britney Spears que quiere mostrar en la escuela.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Mientras los chicos hacen una visita educativa a un museo, Cartman obliga a Butters a que se escabulla de la clase para ir al centro de entretenimiento que está al lado.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman ha logrado “la paz mundial” gracias a una de sus bromas para humillar a Kyle. Este acontecimiento reúne a miles de líderes religiosos de todo el mundo en South Park.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El padre de Butters lo encuentra en una posicion comprometedora con Cartman, por lo que decide enviar a su hijo a un campamento especial.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman teme que Token y otros afroamericanos comiencen un apocalipsis zombi al estilo Guerra Mundial Z, la película de Brad Pitt. Así que corre por todo South Park para poner fin a esta amenaza.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos se van de caza con Jimbo, el tío de Stan, y su viejo amigo Ned. Mientras tanto, un volcán está a punto de hacer erupción y la alcaldesa McDaniels aprovecha la oportunidad para promocionar al pueblo de South Park en televisión.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Por culpa de la baja puntuación en el examen de educación física de Cartman, toda la escuela tiene que renunciar a sus recesos. Indignados, el 99% de la escuela se pone en contra de Cartman.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El Señor Garrison ha decidido hacerse un cambio de sexo y ahora se siente como una verdadera mujer. Mientras tanto, Kyle quiere hacerse una cirugía para ser negro y poder jugar en el equipo de básquetbol.
programme.sub-title: La nueva vagina del Señor Garrison

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Un día de diversión en el parque acuático se torna mortal para los niños.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Nueva Jersey se está expandiendo rápidamente y South Park está en peligro de convertirse en la siguiente ciudad en ser invadida. Randy y los chicos intentarán evitarlo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Una nueva alumna llega a la escuela primaria de South Park y es negra por lo que Cartman cree que debería hacer pareja con Token, y no dejará que nadie se interponga en el camino, en especial Kyle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos encuentran un antiguo objeto triangular en una excavación escolar. Luego de salir en el noticiero, Barbra Streisand aparece buscándolo ya que es lo que necesita para poder convertirse en un monstruo gigante japonés.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle está muy enfermo y su madre trata de curarlo con medicinas naturales de una curandera y sus colaboradores "nativos americanos”. Mientras, el señor Garrison es despedido y se convierte en un escritor de novelas románticas.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy propone un plan para arreglar la situación económica mundial. Mientras tanto, Stan intenta devolver una máquina para hacer margaritas, y un salvador inesperado hace el último sacrificio para resolver los problemas de todos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: En "Imaginaciónlandia", Stan y Butters luchan contra un ejército de fuerzas imaginarias. La Suprema Corte declara que las criaturas imaginarias no son reales y planean destruir "Imaginaciónlandia".

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La última de las pruebas científicas revela que algunos de los chicos de South Park tiene un problema de adicción al sexo.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle firma un contrato con la empresa Apple sin leerlo previamente. Mientras tanto, Cartman enloquece a su mamá porque ésta no le compro un iPad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El primo de Kyle, también llamado Kyle, llega de visita desde Connecticut, ya que su madre está enferma. A pesar de ser de la misma edad, los primos no tienen nada en común.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan y Kyle han sido capturados por el Pentágono para que le digan al gobierno exactamente cómo entraron a "Imaginaciónlandia". Mientras tanto, Cartman no se da por vencido en su apuesta con Kyle.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El show de Cartman es tendencia, mientras que el país se prepara para vivir la fiesta mas espectacular jamás vista.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle quiere jugar a los videojuegos con su hermano menor. Pero cuando Ike no quiere jugar más con él, Kyle teme que la próxima generación lo haya superado.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los japoneses están realizando ataques con el fin de aniquilar a todos los delfines y ballenas del planeta. Ante esta situación, Stan decide toma medidas para detener la matanza.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle se enoja con sus padres por no dejarlo ir al concierto de los Raging Pussies, y Cartman le recomienda que le diga a la policía que sus padres lo masturbaron para que los arresten.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Una apuesta iniciada porque Cartman vio a un duende es el inicio de un problema, aunado a que los chicos se encuentran frente a la totalidad imaginativa del mundo atacada por un grupo terrorista.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se considera el crítico número uno en Internet de restaurantes en South Park.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos intentan cruzar al elefante de Kyle con ''Fofa'', la cerda de Cartman, para un experimento genético de la escuela con el cual intentan ganarle a Terrance. Mientras, Stan lucha contra los abusos físicos de su hermana, Shelly.
programme.sub-title: Un elefante hace el amor con una cerda

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman consigue ganar dinero subiendo videos de unos bebés peleando por una pelotita de crack. Kyle piensa que eso es malo hasta que Cartman lo convence de que no es así.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman le insiste a sus amigos que los ataques terroristas del 11 de Septiembre fueron una conspiración y se dispone a desenmascarar la verdad. Por su parte, el Sr. Mackey quiere saber quién defecó en el baño.

programme.title: Ghost In The Shell

programme.title: America Has Fallen

programme.title: Entrega especial

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Episodio 2207
programme.desc: Stan Marsh, Kyle Broflovski, Eric Cartman y Kenny McCormick cuatro niños de 9 años. A lo largo de la serie se siguen sus aventuras en South Park, un pequeño pueblo montañoso de Colorado en el que viven el resto de personajes.

programme.title: South Park VOSE: Jódete
programme.desc: Los chicos han llamado a su nueva empresa THE WASHINGTON REDSKINS.

programme.title: Tormenta colosal
programme.desc: When a colossal tectonic shift causes the sea level to start rising, a microbiologist gathers the DNA of as many species as she can, while the military creates an "ark" in a desperate attempt to preserve life on Earth.

programme.title: Titanic II
programme.desc: On the 100th anniversary of the original voyage, a modern luxury liner christened "Titanic II," follows the path of its namesake. But when a tsunami hurls an ice berg into the new ship's path, the passengers and crew must fight to avoid a similar fate.

programme.title: La Cima
programme.desc: Después de que un hombre que intenta alcanzar finalmente su objetivo de escalar el Annapurna sufre un accidente, una escaladora que ha estado buscando refugio intenta ayudarlo.

programme.title: La aventura del Poseidón: Capítulo 1
programme.desc: El Poseidón es un enorme transatlántico de lujo que naufraga cuando unos terroristas hacen estallar unas bombas en pleno océano. El hundimiento sorprende a todos en plena nochevieja, y a partir de entonces los supervivientes intentarán ponerse a salvo.

programme.title: 10.000 días
programme.desc: Hace 10.000 días, un cometa impactó con la Tierra en pleno océano Pacífico con la fuerza de incontables bombas nucleares, sumiendo al planeta en nieve y hielo.

programme.title: Amor de ida y vuelta
programme.desc: Dos actores de fenómenos televisivos (Juego de Tronos y Sex Education) protagonizan este fantástico romance. Un joven (Asa Butterfield) inventa una máquina del tiempo para recuperar a su exnovia (Sophie Turner).

programme.title: El juego de Ender
programme.desc: Harrison Ford, Asa Butterfield, Hailee Steinfeld, Ben Kingsley, Viola Davis y Abigail Breslin protagonizan esta aventura de ciencia ficción repleta de acción basada en la novela superventas.

programme.title: Infinitum
programme.desc: Jane debe cambiar su realidad en un universo paralelo por su cuenta.

programme.title: La señal, el balneario
programme.desc: En un viaje por carretera, Nic y dos amigos son atraídos a una zona aislada por un genio de la informática. Cuando de repente todo se vuelve oscuro, Nic recupera la consciencia, solo para encontrarse en una pesadilla al despertar.

programme.title: Historias apocalípticas
programme.desc: Tras sobrevivir a una pandemia mundial, dos hombre con agendas muy distintas, dos mujeres de una colonia de supervivientes, una joven y un hombre forman alianzas cuando sus caminos se cruzan en paisajes postapocalípticos.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers ES
programme.desc: El viernes 12 de enero de 2007 hallan el cuerpo sin vida y mutilado de una mujer en el bosque de Rambouillet.

programme.title: Misterios sin resolver: Episodio 1
programme.desc: Presentado por Robert Stack, esta serie usa recreaciones y entrevistas para volver a narrar las circunstancias de los misterios que permanecen sin resolver. Cubriendo crímenes, historias de un amor perdido, historias inexplicadas y eventos paranormales.

programme.title: Misterios sin resolver: Episodio 2
programme.desc: Presentado por Robert Stack, esta serie usa recreaciones y entrevistas para volver a narrar las circunstancias de los misterios que permanecen sin resolver. Cubriendo crímenes, historias de un amor perdido, historias inexplicadas y eventos paranormales.

programme.title: Misterios sin resolver: Episodio 3

programme.title: Casos Sin Resolver
programme.desc: A las 23h35 del martes 13 de mayo de 2003, Patrice Baud, neurólogo de 46 años y padre de cinco hijos, salió de su consultorio médico situado en el número 16 de la calle Hédelin, en Nemours.

programme.title: Contra Reloj
programme.desc: La muerte de Jean-Bernard Wiktorska, que inicialmente se creyó que había sido un accidente, tomó un giro siniestro cuando un misterioso informante implicó a su esposa y a su amante en el asesinato.

programme.title: Contra Reloj
programme.desc: Un día antes de cumplir 18 años, el cuerpo de Marie Varnerot, una joven de 17 años, fue encontrado semidesnudo en su cama en Maincy, cerca de Melun.
programme.sub-title: Asesinada en la víspera de la edad adulta

programme.title: Evidencias del Crimen: Caso Françoise Desnoue
programme.desc: En un pequeño pueblo de Bougrogne, Éric Desnoue, de 52 años, denuncia la desaparición de su esposa a la policía.

programme.title: Evidencias del Crimen: Estuche Jean-Jacques Le Page
programme.desc: En la mañana del 24 de julio de 2009, se produce un incendio en una casa de Plougonvelin.

programme.title: Evidencias del Crimen: Caso Josiane Bézard
programme.desc: En la mañana del 9 de enero de 2014, Josiane Bézard, de 53 años, lleva a su hijo a la estación de tren de Manosque y luego desaparece.

programme.title: Evidencias del Crimen: Caso Evelyne Boucher
programme.desc: El 9 de diciembre de 1987, el cuerpo desnudo de la joven Evelyne Boucher es encontrado cerca de Avignon.

programme.title: Evidencias del Crimen: Caso Céline Marchand
programme.desc: El 30 de mayo de 2015 en Sorinières, Yann Machand denuncia la desaparición de su esposa Céline Marchand.

programme.title: Evidencias del Crimen: Caso Sylvie Darcy
programme.desc: Alrededor de las 11 de la noche, se llama a la policía para un asalto en un estacionamiento en el bosque de Saint-Lambert-des-Bois.

programme.title: Cruise Ship Killers
programme.desc: Una luna de miel en crucero se convierte en una pesadilla cuando la novia es supuestamente lanzada desde un balcón en plena noche. Pero al llegar el informe meteorológico, que no muestra viento esa noche, comienza una investigación por asesinato.

programme.title: Cruise Ship Killers
programme.desc: Unas vacaciones sorpresa en crucero para una pareja de Olympia, Washington, termina con uno de ellos cayendo por la borda. ¿Fue venganza, celos o un impulso asesino en alta mar?

programme.title: Mapas de Asesinatos
programme.desc: En 1849, un hombre desapareció repentinamente en Bermondsey.

programme.title: Mapas de Asesinatos
programme.desc: En la época de Jack El Destripador, Londres era el hogar de algunos de los individuos más terribles que la ciudad jamás haya visto. Uno de los peores fue el escurridizo Borough Poisoner, George Chapman.
programme.sub-title: A la sombra de Jack El destripador

programme.title: Linda Napolitano: La Abducción Alienígena del Siglo
programme.desc: La abducción alienígena de Linda Napolitano en 1989 es el caso de abducción del siglo.

programme.title: Extraterrestres contra la Guerra Nuclear: Edgar Mitchell
programme.desc: 12 caminantes lunares afirman que los extraterrestres visitaron la Tierra, el gobierno lo encubrió. Los extraterrestres detuvieron la guerra nuclear. ¿Loco o vale la pena escuchar más?

programme.desc: Michael K. Wolf comparte 30 años de ideas sobre ovnis, extraterrestres, proyectos gubernamentales y círculos de las cosechas.

programme.title: Extraterrestres Subterráneos, Baba Vanga y Biología Cuántica
programme.desc: Baba Vanga, una mística búlgara ciega, hizo predicciones desde los 12 años hasta su muerte en 1996. Sus profecías se extendieron hasta el año 5079.

programme.desc: ¿Quiénes son los alienígenas grises y cuál es su interés en nuestro mundo? En este documental exploramos los posibles motivos detrás de tres de los encuentros más prolíficos en nuestra historia.

programme.title: Encubrimientos y Conspiraciones: El Globo Espía Chino
programme.desc: Objetos derribados en el espacio aéreo de Estados Unidos y Canadá. El Pentágono finge ignorancia. ¿Participación alienígena?

programme.desc: Una familia lucha contra los alienígenas goblins en un misterioso encuentro, lo que provoca debates e investigaciones. El miedo impulsa sus acciones.

programme.desc: 2005: Ex agente revela un informe de 3.000 páginas sobre una misión secreta de intercambio ET al planeta Serpo

programme.desc: El documental analiza los avistamientos masivos de extraterrestres, cuestiona la fiabilidad de las explicaciones oficiales e identifica patrones comunes para una mayor investigación.

programme.title: El malvado Zaroff

programme.title: Ausentes
programme.desc: Julia y Samuel se mudan con los niños a una urbanización en las afueras de la ciudad. Parece un lugar ideal, pero Julia pronto descubrirá que tan idílico paraje esconde algo extraño. Se da cuenta de que la urbanización está completamente desierta.

programme.title: La Senda
programme.desc: En un intento por salvar su matrimonio, Raúl decide pasar las Navidades con su familia en una cabaña aislada en medio de la nieve. Durante la Nochebuena todo parece marchar bien, pero, de repente, la situación da un giro totalmente inesperado.

programme.title: Dictado
programme.desc: Tras quedarse huérfana, Julia es acogida por Daniel y Laura. Daniel percibe en la conducta de la niña un carácter amenazador que le trae a la memoria un pasado terrorífico que había decidido enterrar para siempre.

programme.title: Dark Angel
programme.desc: La relación de Alex y Evan toma un giro diferente a medida que ambos comienzan de nuevo. Kelly da un salto hacia lo desconocido y Christian propone a Chloe, el nuevo jefe de Miranda, con una canción.

programme.title: Dark Angel
programme.desc: Kelly tiene la mejor noche de su vida, mientras que Alex y Rex tienen una de las más difíciles. Evan se sumerge en el mundo publicitario.

programme.title: The Dead Girl ES
programme.desc: El asesinato de una joven reúne las historias de cinco mujeres: Lonely Arden descubre el cuerpo, Leah cree que la víctima puede ser su hermana desaparecida. Melora cree que es su hija, mientras que Ruth hace un descubrimiento aterrador.

programme.title: Oscuras intenciones
programme.desc: Molly is struggling with being a new mom, but after meeting Beth, things temporarily improve only to turn as Beth's dark intentions are brought to light.

programme.title: A pleno sol

programme.title: Mutante X

programme.title: Mutante X
programme.desc: Shalimar se vuelve más cercana a otro salvaje cuando es "lujuria a primera vista", pero las cosas se complican cuando su nuevo novio intenta encontrar una cura para su condición.

programme.title: Mutante X

programme.title: Stochelo Rosenberg & Peter Beets
programme.desc: The treasured compositions of guitarist Django Reinhardt, the founding father of hot club jazz, are engraved in everyone's memory. Although Reinhardt missed two fingers of his left hand, his virtuoso technique was unrivalled. Dutch guitarist Stochelo Rosenberg and pianist Peter Beets now have the pleasure to bring Django's music back to life with their infectious improvisations.

programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Richard Easley, Thornel Schwartz & Jimmy McGriff
programme.sub-title: Comblain-la-Tour Jazz Festival: Jimmy McGriff Trio
programme.desc: As one of the best Hammond B3 organ players, Jimmy McGriff (1936-2008) is often lost among great soul-jazz organists from his hometown of Philadelphia. Of the major soul-jazz pioneers, he was the bluesiest and often insisted that he was more of a blues musician than a jazz artist. Regardless, he remained eclectic enough to blur the lines of genres. His sound - deep, down-to-earth grooves drenched in blues and gospel feeling - made him popular with R&B audiences. This 1965 performance is part of the Comblain-la-Tour Jazz Festival.

programme.title: Charles Mingus
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Louis Armstrong
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly! He made assorted television appearances, especially in the 1950s and 1960s – the recorded film was a TV Show in Australia when Armstrong was at the peak of his career. Armstrong kept up his busy tour schedule until a few years before his death in 1971. He also toured Africa, Europe, and Asia under sponsorship of the US State Department with great success, earning the nickname ‘Ambassador Satch'.

programme.title: Kenny Barron
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron's June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine's Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Marcus Miller
programme.desc: This portrait of Marcus Miller was recorded during his 2009 ‘Tutu Revisited' tour. Miller looks back on his relationship with Miles Davis. Miller tells us about writing his composition 'Tutu', and shares countless stories of the recording process of the album 'Tutu'. This documentary was filmed in 2009 at the 'We Want Miles' exhibition in Cité de la Musique in Paris.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk, Charlie Rouse, Ben Riley & Larry Gales
programme.desc: The idiosyncratic pianist and composer Thelonious Monk (1917-1982) is one of the all-time greats of jazz. His music went largely misunderstood for the first 15 years of his career, after which he was rightly hailed as a genius, and received credit as a founding father of bebop. Several concerts from his 1966 European tour were recorded for television, featuring his quartet of Charles Rouse (tenor saxophone), Lawrence Gales (bass) and Benjamin Riley (drums). His quartet performed Epistrophy, 'Round Midnight, and Lulu's Back in Town in Warsaw for Polish television on April 4, 1966. On April 17, the same quartet performed a short set in Copenhagen for Danish television, featuring Lulu's Back in Town, Don't Blame Me, and Epistrophy.

programme.title: Milt Jackson, John Lewis, Percy Heath & Connie Kay
programme.sub-title: Milt Jacksons' Modern Jazz Quartet at the Bozar
programme.desc: The Modern Jazz Quartet (MJQ) was composed of Milt 'Bags' Jackson on vibraphone, John Lewis on piano, Percy Heath on bass, and Connie Kay on drums. Milt Jackson and John Lewis were pioneer bebop musicians who had played together in Dizzy Gillespie's 1948 big band. They pursued separate careers before adding Heath and Lewis to form the Modern Jazz Quartet in the 1950s. Noted for its delicate percussion sonorities, innovative jazz forms, and high performance standards, the MJQ was an immensely popular jazz and “third stream” ensemble until its final concerts in the early 1990s.

programme.title: Maynard Ferguson
programme.sub-title: Winter 1980: Maynard Ferguson Big Band in Brussels
programme.desc: The Brussels Jazz Club was filled to the brim with both musicians and audience members when the Maynard Ferguson Big Band performed there during their Winter Tour of 1980. From the first notes of the cover of Weather Report's “Birdland” that opens the performance to the final notes of “Gonna Fly Now” that closes it, Ferguson gives his young sidemen ample time to shine. The mutual admiration shared by the leader and his sidemen makes this performance a delight to watch.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés, Concha Buika, Rodney Barreto & Dreiser Durruthy Bombale
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne' is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2013 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them were Chucho Valdes and his Afro-Cuban Messengers, the prime example of Latin-inspired jazz music. Together with vocalists Concha Buika and Dreiser Durruthy Bombale, Rodney Barreto on drums, Gaston Joya on double bass, Yaroldy Abreu Robles on congas, and Reinaldo Melian Alvarez on trumpet, the legendary pianist brings the streets of Havana to the festival's stage.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto & Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 6 is a monumental work exploring deep personal tragedy, incorporating a unique, famous "hammer" blows that symbolize the inevitable blows of fate. This symphony's intense emotional power, epic scope, and the composer's eventual wrestling with fate and personal loss make it an unforgettable, profoundly moving experience for audiences.

programme.title: Valery Gergiev
programme.desc: This visually stunning production of Nutcracker is a graceful and timeless adventure on a grand scale. From the lovely Waltz of the Flowers to the crystalline beauty of the stunning Snowflake Waltz, each scene is more breathtaking than the last, bringing to life all the well-known and beloved characters with fresh sparkle and compelling originality. It is Christmas Eve and we are brought to a party at which Drosselmeyer gives young Clara a nutcracker doll - beginning a night that includes a magically growing Christmas tree, a midnight battle of toy soldiers at which the Nutcracker defeats the villainous Mouse King and his army of mice, and a headlong pas de deux in which Clara and Hans-Peter meet and celebrate their triumph before being enveloped in a magical snowstorm. Act II whisks the young pair off to the Kingdom of the Sweets, where they are entertained by the Sugar Plum Fairy with her handsome Prince and her glittering court in a series of dazzling dances. Under the direction of Andreas Morell, Valery Gergiev conducts the Mariinsky Orchestra and Choir. Soloists are Mikhail Makarov, lldar Abdrazakov, Anna Markarova, Sergei Skorokhodov, Timur Abdikeyev, Vladislav Sulimasky. This production was recorded at the Mariinsky Theatre in 2012.

programme.title: Les Dissonances
programme.sub-title: Mozart - String Quartet No. 19 in C major, K. 465
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances' string quartet – consisting of David Grimal (violin), Hans Peter Hofmann (violin), David Gaillard (viola), and Xavier Phillips (cello) – performs Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's String Quartet No. 19 in C major, K. 465, ‘Dissonance' (Op. 10 No. 6). The String Quartet is the last in the set of six quartets that were dedicated to Joseph Haydn. Written between 1782 and 1785, these are also known as the Haydn Quartets (Op. 10). String Quartet No. 19 is remarkable for its slow, dissonant introduction, giving the piece its nickname. This ominous passage suddenly gives way to the bright Allegro in C major. This performance was recorded at Opéra Comique in Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: amarcordplus & Sebastian Heindl
programme.sub-title: Baroque choral music by Bach, Schütz et al.
programme.desc: Five-strong vocal ensemble amarcord is joined by an extra alto and two soprano voices for this unusual concert at Leipzig's St. Thomas Church. As amarcordplus, the ensemble presents a program focused on the city of Leipzig, which includes sacred madrigals by Johann Hermann Schein, motets from Heinrich Schütz's collection Geistliche Chor-Music, as well as two motets by the most famous Thomaskantor: Johann Sebastian Bach. Moreover, various sacred works by lesser-known contemporaries Philipp Heinrich Erlebach and mononymous composer Liebhold are performed, in addition to compositions by other members of the Bach family, including Johann Michael Bach and Johann Christoph Bach. This performance was recorded on May 1, 2020.

programme.title: Florian Boesch, Iwona Sobotka, Robert Murray & Anna Stephany
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) and Chorus in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. The soloists are Iwona Sobotka (soprano), Anna Stephany (mezzo-soprano), Robert Murray (tenor), and Florian Boesch (baritone). Engineered with unmatched symphonic finesse, Beethoven set aside ruminations on fate and heroism to compose his utterly musical and wholly satisfying Ninth Symphony. It is a monumental work, renowned for its innovative use of a chorus and vocal soloists in the final movement, singing a setting of Friedrich Schiller's poem "Ode to Joy". Premiered in 1824, it remains one of the most performed and recognizable pieces of classical music. This performance was recorded at Barbican Hall in London, on February 16, 2020.

programme.title: David Grimal & Les Dissonances
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Violin Concerto No. 5 in A major, K. 219, also known as the ‘Turkish Concerto'. Leading violinist Grimal features as the soloist. With the exception of the first violin concerto, Mozart composed his other four violin concertos in 1775 at a time when he was concertmaster at the Salzburg court. It is the third and final movement that gives Concerto No. 5 its nickname, the ‘Turkish Concerto'. This movement features a striking middle section of ‘Turkish music', which the composer achieves not only by changing the meter, and the mode to minor, but also by letting the cellos and basses play col legno - creating a percussive sound with the wood of their bow. This performance was recorded at Cité de la Musique, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Ana María Paño-Osorio & Philharmonie de Paris
programme.sub-title: Sinfonía por el Perú from Philharmonie de Paris
programme.desc: Superstar tenor Juan Diego Flórez brings to life the most iconic roles of the bel canto repertoire, joined by the vibrant young musicians of Sinfonía por el Perú, led by the celebrated conductor Ana María Patiño-Osorio! Embark on a lyrical adventure with them, from the powerful drama of Bellini's I Capuleti e I Montecchi and the majestic Jerusalem by Verdi, to the boisterous and spirited cancan of Offenbach's operetta Orpheus in the Underworld. Sinfonía por el Perú is a nonprofit organization founded by Juan Diego Flórez, with a mission to inspire social change through collective music education. Since its inception in 2011, over six thousand young Peruvians have embraced the opportunity to play an instrument or sing in a choir. Students from the program have graced the world's most prestigious stages, from Salzburg to Gstaad, including the Lucerne Festival, and they accompany Juan Diego Flórez for this concert.

programme.title: John Denver
programme.sub-title: Rocky Mountain High: Live In Japan
programme.desc: Arguably one of the most beloved American performers of the 20th century, John Denver had a career that saw him sell over 40 million albums worldwide while winning numerous awards, including 2 Grammy Awards, 3 AMA's, 1 Emmy and 2 CMA's. "Rocky Mountain High: Live In Japan" is a 1981 concert from his 7-show tour of Japan and features a wonderful selection of hits from his career, including 4 of his 5 #1 hits: "Annie's Song", "Calypso", "Sunshine On My Shoulders" & "Thank God I'm A Country Boy".

programme.title: John Mellencamp
programme.desc: John Mellencamp's career in music, spanning more than 42 years, has seen him transition from pop star to one of the most highly regarded songwriters of a generation. Filmed at the landmark Chicago Theatre, just 250 miles away from his upbringing in Indiana, this cinematic concert documentary film captures John Mellencamp reflecting on his career accompanied by self-narration from his highly personal audio diary on his Midwestern upbringing, career and outlook on life as a whole. Meant to be more than just your run of the mill concert film, this intimate performance with full band will fully envelop the viewer into the Mellencamp mindset. “My vision was true, and my heart was too. And there was no end to what I could dream. Life is short, even in its longest days.”

programme.title: The Dresser
programme.desc: In this wickedly funny and moving story, Sir reflects on his accomplishments and seeks to reconcile his turbulent friendships with those in his employ before the final curtain.

programme.title: Peacock
programme.desc: John Skillpa, a quiet bank clerk living in tiny Peacock, Nebraska, prefers to live an invisible life. This might have to do with John's secret: he has another personality no one knows about, a woman who each morning cooks him breakfast before he starts his day. Then, in a moment, everything changes.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks
programme.desc: A struggling songwriter named Dave Seville finds success when he comes across a trio of singing chipmunks: mischievous leader Alvin, brainy Simon, and chubby, impressionable Theodore.

programme.title: Just My Luck
programme.desc: Sexy Manhattanite Ashley is known as the luckiest woman around, but after a chance romantic encounter with down-and-out Jake, she realizes that she's swapped her fortune for his.

programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel
programme.desc: The world famous singing pre-teen chipmunk trio return to contend with the pressures of school, celebrity, and a rival female music group known as The Chipettes.

programme.title: Spy Dog
programme.desc: Toby appears to be an ordinary dog living the simple put life, but unbeknownst to his family, he moonlights as secret government operative, Agent Toby Barks. AKA Agent Toby Barks

programme.title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
programme.desc: Alice tumbles into Wonderland, a dream realm filled with peculiar characters like the White Rabbit, March Hare, Queen of Hearts, and Dormouse. As she seeks her way home, she meets strange beings and discovers herself.

programme.title: David Copperfield
programme.desc: This legendary story by Charles Dickens gets a colorful makeover with Delbert Mann at the helm as director.

programme.title: Murder in the Vineyard
programme.desc: Emma and her teenage daughter Beatrice have moved from the big city to a smaller town. Emma's career is thriving, and Beatrice makes friends easily, even catching the eye of high school heart-throb Bryan. But things go downhill when Emma is hazed by an unknown assailant at a party. No one can understand why she is being increasingly bullied and harassed. Emma will do anything to protect her daughter from the mysterious bullies, but is a mother's love enough to save her when things turn deadly?

programme.title: Mary Shelley
programme.desc: The torrid true-life tale of how a passionate love affair fueled the creation of trailblazing writer Mary Shelley's Gothic masterwork, Frankenstein. Elle Fanning stars.

programme.title: Reuniting the Rubins
programme.desc: Lenny Rubins, (Timothy Spall - The King's Speech) an up-tight lawyer, has to put his dream retirement on hold when his ailing mother (Honor Blackman - Goldfinger) emotionally blackmails him into reuniting his estranged children for a Jewish holiday.

programme.title: The King Of Comedy
programme.desc: A struggling comedian gambles his uncertain future on a crazy scheme to ransom his way onto television by kidnapping a popular talk show host.

programme.title: The Heist
programme.desc: Lonely Maiden Productions, LLC. All Rights Reserved. Under exclusive license to Signature Entertainment Ltd 2008

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: As the officers try to hunt down the killer of Brian Gowdy – Andy and Sam go on the road for interviews.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Oliver prepares Andy to defend herself at Duncan's dismissal hearing, now happening two hours from now.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: An innocuous call to a middle-class home puts Dov and Chris in the middle of a home invasion investigation.

programme.title: A Dangerous Method
programme.desc: A look at how the intense relationship between Carl Jung and Sigmund Freud gives birth to psychoanalysis.

programme.title: The King's Speech
programme.desc: After his impromptu ascension to the throne, a speech therapist helps King George VI overcome his stammer.

programme.title: G-Loc
programme.desc: In a world on the brink of environmental collapse, mass migration to neighbouring planet, Rhea, is humanity's final hope for survival. The only problem is, in the sixteen Earth years since the first humans landed on Rhea, two hundred and eighty-eight years have passed on the new planet and the existing population are no longer welcoming new arrivals, with the Rheans having set up a space blockade to shot down any ship that tries to cross into their territory. 'Earther', Bran, has big dreams of a better life in this new world, but the odds are stacked against him. Finding himself the lone survivor of a failed emigration attempt, his escape pod floats mindlessly in space and his oxygen is running low. His only chance of survival is to hook up to a rogue Rhean supply ship called The Nysa running on auxiliary power. But after finding the crew on board The Nysa dead, it seems Bran may have more than just a hostile planet to worry about. An intense interstellar thriller with an impressive cast, including Stephen Moyer (True Blood), Casper Van Dien (Starship Troopers) and John Rhys-Davies (the Indiana Jones and Lord of the Rings franchises).

programme.title: For the Love of Benji
programme.desc: Benji is on holiday with his family in Greece, but after getting separated at the airport, he finds himself on another exciting adventure, now on the run from international spies!

programme.title: Benji
programme.desc: Benji makes his cinematic debut as the beloved dog who has captured the heart of the town. When his favourite friends are kidnapped, Benji sets out to track them down and save the day.

programme.title: 12 in a Box
programme.desc: 12 IN A BOX is the laugh-out-loud story of 12 former school friends who get together for a reunion they will never forget, where they are given the chance to win a life-changing 1million each. The only catch is, they cannot leave the estate for 96 hours, and anyone who enters the grounds must also stay for the duration! With time ticking away, the mismatched dozen are forced to work together to keep the peace and work toward their payday. But, when they have to deal with an untimely death, a kidnapping plot, another corpse, burglars, and then even a visit from the boys in blue, will this hapless clan be able to hold it together or will their dreams of riches be buried with the bodies? Staring Miranda Hart (Miranda, Call the Midwife) and Katy Wix (Not Going Out), this is classic British farce at its best.

programme.title: It's a Boy Girl Thing
programme.desc: It's A Boy Girl Thing is a brilliantly funny romantic comedy about next-door neighbours who live worlds apart. Woody Deane (Zegers) and Nell Bedworth (Armstrong) are life long sworn enemies who wake up one day to find themselves in a very strange place: each others bodies. In their switched identities, each sets out to destroy the other's high school reputation. When they start to succeed they get more than they bargained for. Sometimes falling in love can be an out of body experience.

programme.title: The Spy Gone North
programme.desc: A critically-acclaimed, edge of your seat spy thriller from director Jong-bin Yoon. 1993 Korea, the Cold War continues and tensions surrounding the development of nuclear weapons escalate. Seok-young Park, an army major in the South Korea military intelligence is assigned to infiltrate the North Korean nuclear facility. However, he soon learns a secret that is shared by both nations.

programme.title: Made in Auschwitz
programme.desc: This is the harrowing and shocking story of Auschwitz Block 10. Based on the life of 10 women during the Holocaust, who were preyed upon by sadistic and narcissistic German doctor Carl Clauberg. Promising pregnancy, he instead inflicted inhumane experiments, under Nazi instruction, for recognition and his will to produce results that would have made a second genocide very possible.

programme.title: Slightly Single in LA
programme.desc: Fun, flirty and downright outrageous. Independent, LA singleton Dale (Lacey Chabert, Mean Girls) is sick and tired of her troublesome love life. On the verge of giving up, she is reunited with an old friend - successful heartthrob and rock star Zach. Is this Dale's lucky chance to fall in love? Also starring Jenna Dewan (Step Up) and Jonathan Bennett (Mean Girls). Perfect for a girls night in!

programme.title: Iron Mask
programme.desc: The Iron Mask' follows English traveller Jonathan Green as he journeys from Russia to China encountering dragons, black magic wizardry and a dragon king during an incredible but deadly adventure.

programme.title: The Beaver
programme.desc: Two-time Academy Award winner Jodie Foster directs and co-stars with two-time Academy Award winner Mel Gibson in The Beaver - an emotional story about a man on a journey to re-discover his family and re-start his life.

programme.title: The Man Without a Face
programme.desc: A drama film about a young boy who befriends a disfigured recluse in a small coastal town and helps him overcome his fear of society and confront his past.

programme.title: Céline
programme.desc: Céline tells the unforgettable love story of one of the most compelling celebrity couples of all time and chronicles the rise to fame of the world's greatest pop superstar.

programme.title: Life at These Speeds
programme.desc: After a teenager's friends are killed in an accident, he finds running allows him to remember them perfectly. Running, however, also brings him notoriety. Soon he finds himself caught between keeping the past alive and making new memories in the present.

programme.title: The Ark
programme.desc: The Ark is a retelling of the biblical story of Noah and The Ark. Noah, a farmer and family man, is instructed by an angel to build an ark in the middle of a desert in order to save both his family and the faithful from a devastating flood.

programme.title: Never Too Late To Celebrate
programme.desc: (2023) Romance with Alexa and Carlos PenaVega. Camila has no plans to celebrate her 30th. But when her Spanish tutor suggests a 'double quinceañera' to honour her Hispanic heritage, will sparks fly?

programme.title: One Perfect Match
programme.desc: (2023) Charming romcom with Merritt Patterson and Joshua Sasse. Love gets complicated for Seattle's top matchmaker when sparks fly with a mystery man, who turns out to be her new client...

programme.title: Valentine Ever After
programme.desc: Keen to escape the big city, Julia and Sydney head to Wyoming for a fun getaway. However, the trip sees Julia re-evaluate her life choices, including her career and the man she truly loves. (2016)

programme.title: Love Off the Page
programme.desc: (2022) Rom-com starring Malone Thomas. A hopeless romantic buys a book from a mysterious store, only to find its stories unfolding in real life. Will it depict her own love story?

programme.title: Love Takes Flight
programme.desc: Single mum Lizzy has built boundaries at work and personal life to protect herself. After meeting an impulsive pilot, Charlie, at work, will she be open to change and open herself up to love? (2019)

programme.title: Leading Lady
programme.desc: Jodi, an idealistic British drama teacher, travels to a South African town to prepare for a major film role. In rehearsals Jodi's interactions with quirky locals may teach her that there is more to life than lights... camera... and action!

programme.title: A Little Something For Your Birthday
programme.desc: Senna, a struggling designer who hasn't quite found herself has given up on finding her soulmate. Despite attempts, by her best friend, to get her to settle down and pursue her passion of fashion, Senna continues down a path of irresponsible behaviour, lost jobs, and casual hook-ups with younger men

programme.title: Not Another Happy Ending
programme.desc: When struggling publisher Tom Duval discovers his only successful author, Jane Lockhart, has writer's block, he knows he has to help.

programme.title: I Could Never Be Your Woman
programme.desc: An upbeat and acerbic romantic comedy featuring stellar cast: Michelle Pfeiffer, Paul Rudd, Saoirse Ronan, Jon Lovitz, Stacey Dash, Fred Willard, Sarah Alexander, Tracey Ullman, Henry Winkler.

programme.title: Wuthering Heights (1970)
programme.desc: A passionate adaptation of Emily Brontë's superbly strange and hauntingly enduring classic novel, starring Timothy Dalton and Anna Calder-Marshall as the doomed and deathless lovers, Heathcliff and Cathy. Directed by Robert Fuest.

programme.title: You May Not Kiss the Bride
programme.desc: Bryan is a quiet, photographer but when he falls foul of local gangsters, he is forced to marry the boss's daughter, Masha, in order for her to get her green card. They are sent to a remote tropical island for a honeymoon that is far from idyllic.

programme.title: Bridal Boot Camp
programme.desc: Andy Phillips is preparing for her upcoming wedding with her fiancé, Jordan. However, after chatting with her best friend, Andy starts to question if she has what it takes to make a strong a lasting marriage.

programme.title: Wedding Bells
programme.desc: When her best friend Amy has her wedding put in jeopardy, Molly decides to help in any way she can. Unfortunately, this means working together with Nick, the groom's best man and head chef of the hottest new restaurant in New York.

programme.desc: Meeting at a Halloween party, Matt and Sara have an instant connection, but they agree to not exchange numbers. What they don't realize is that by meeting, they've set in motion events that will change both their lives in magical ways.

programme.title: Finding Love In Mountain View
programme.desc: After learning she's been entrusted to take care of her deceased cousin's children, an architect is torn between focusing on her career and honoring her cousin's wish.

programme.desc: Sparks fly between an interior designer and a handsome pilot who finds homes for rescue dogs.

Fed up with the way they've all been treated, she's off to war against the reigning campus royalty.

programme.desc: An unlikely group of former '80s video game champions step up to save the world from an alien invasion in this visually spectacular action-adventure.

programme.desc: When Alia returns home from university, she challenges her parents' elitist lifestyle expensive jewellery, lavish dinner parties, and gossiping aunties. But when she invites the son of a local shopkeeper to her mother's upcoming soiree, family secrets begin to surface.

programme.desc: Doug was an amazing fighter, but a less than amazing businessman. Saddled with a gym in debt he is struggling to keep his business afloat. Now he will have to try and save his beloved gym from being turned into a modern chain-gym by training a gentle giant for a bare-knuckle figh.

programme.title: Tequila aka Fuzzy the Hero
programme.desc: Tequila and Bobo hit the little town of Chedron intending to rob the local bank whose owner, De Koven, is trying to freeze out all the ranchers in the area by the simple expedient of foreclosing on the mortgages his bank holds on their land.

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands, a former Texas marshal turned fugitive, hides in Mexico after his gun skills made him an outlaw. When he learns his brother Billy, a crusading newspaperman, has been murdered in Sentinel, Texas, John risks his life to return north. Despite the bounty on his head, he's determined to uncover the truth and avenge his brother's death.

programme.title: The Southerner
programme.desc: The life of the poor Tucker family, that worked as cotton pluggers and decided to get their own ground, but nature is against them.

programme.title: In a Colt's Shadow
programme.desc: A story about two gunfighters, Duke and Steve. Steve is in love with Duke's daughter but Duke disapproves of the match, envisioning a life of hardship and danger for the girl if she marries Steve.

programme.title: A Town Called Hell
programme.desc: A group of Mexican revolutionaries murders a town priest and a number of his christian followers. Ten years later, a widow arrives in town intent to take revenge from her husband's killers.

programme.title: On the Night of the Fire
programme.desc: Kobling is a barber who steals £100 to pay off his wife's debt.

programme.title: Feminine Touch
programme.desc: Five young women arrive at St. Augustine's Hospital to take up a nursing career. They are told by the matron of the hardships and possible satisfactions that lie ahead of them. All succeed in passing their preliminary examination, and one of them falls in love with a young house doctor, Jim Alcott. She decides to give up her career to marry him, but later the experience of helping to save a patient's life and of giving fresh hope to a woman who has attempted suicide makes her change her mind and put duty first. However, the example of one of her friends who gets married and the advice of the matron persuades Susan to share Jim's career in the wilds of Canada.

programme.title: Stochelo Rosenberg & Peter Beets
programme.desc: The treasured compositions of guitarist Django Reinhardt, the founding father of hot club jazz, are engraved in everyone's memory. Although Reinhardt missed two fingers of his left hand, his virtuoso technique was unrivalled. Dutch guitarist Stochelo Rosenberg and pianist Peter Beets now have the pleasure to bring Django's music back to life with their infectious improvisations.

programme.title: Richard Easley, Thornel Schwartz & Jimmy McGriff
programme.sub-title: Comblain-la-Tour Jazz Festival: Jimmy McGriff Trio
programme.desc: As one of the best Hammond B3 organ players, Jimmy McGriff (1936-2008) is often lost among great soul-jazz organists from his hometown of Philadelphia. Of the major soul-jazz pioneers, he was the bluesiest and often insisted that he was more of a blues musician than a jazz artist. Regardless, he remained eclectic enough to blur the lines of genres. His sound - deep, down-to-earth grooves drenched in blues and gospel feeling - made him popular with R&B audiences. This 1965 performance is part of the Comblain-la-Tour Jazz Festival.

programme.title: Charles Mingus

programme.title: Louis Armstrong
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly! He made assorted television appearances, especially in the 1950s and 1960s – the recorded film was a TV Show in Australia when Armstrong was at the peak of his career. Armstrong kept up his busy tour schedule until a few years before his death in 1971. He also toured Africa, Europe, and Asia under sponsorship of the US State Department with great success, earning the nickname ‘Ambassador Satch'.

programme.title: Kenny Barron
programme.desc: Pianist Kenny Barron's June 27, 2019 appearance at the Alfa Jazz Festival in Ukraine's Lviv was a celebration of sublime jazz virtuosity. The revered elder statesmen of jazz piano brought his regular working trio of Kiyoshi Kitagawa (bass) and Jonathan Blake (drums), augmented by stellar jazzman Marcus Strickland (tenor saxophone) and young lion Riley Mulherkar (trumpet). Their seamless blend of classic bebop and modern explorations spoke of a deep, emotive connection to each note, captivating the Ukrainian audience with lyrical improvisations during this unforgettable concert.

programme.title: Marcus Miller
programme.desc: This portrait of Marcus Miller was recorded during his 2009 ‘Tutu Revisited' tour. Miller looks back on his relationship with Miles Davis. Miller tells us about writing his composition 'Tutu', and shares countless stories of the recording process of the album 'Tutu'. This documentary was filmed in 2009 at the 'We Want Miles' exhibition in Cité de la Musique in Paris.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk, Charlie Rouse, Ben Riley & Larry Gales
programme.desc: The idiosyncratic pianist and composer Thelonious Monk (1917-1982) is one of the all-time greats of jazz. His music went largely misunderstood for the first 15 years of his career, after which he was rightly hailed as a genius, and received credit as a founding father of bebop. Several concerts from his 1966 European tour were recorded for television, featuring his quartet of Charles Rouse (tenor saxophone), Lawrence Gales (bass) and Benjamin Riley (drums). His quartet performed Epistrophy, 'Round Midnight, and Lulu's Back in Town in Warsaw for Polish television on April 4, 1966. On April 17, the same quartet performed a short set in Copenhagen for Danish television, featuring Lulu's Back in Town, Don't Blame Me, and Epistrophy.

programme.title: Milt Jackson, John Lewis, Percy Heath & Connie Kay
programme.sub-title: Milt Jacksons' Modern Jazz Quartet at the Bozar
programme.desc: The Modern Jazz Quartet (MJQ) was composed of Milt 'Bags' Jackson on vibraphone, John Lewis on piano, Percy Heath on bass, and Connie Kay on drums. Milt Jackson and John Lewis were pioneer bebop musicians who had played together in Dizzy Gillespie's 1948 big band. They pursued separate careers before adding Heath and Lewis to form the Modern Jazz Quartet in the 1950s. Noted for its delicate percussion sonorities, innovative jazz forms, and high performance standards, the MJQ was an immensely popular jazz and “third stream” ensemble until its final concerts in the early 1990s.

programme.title: Maynard Ferguson
programme.sub-title: Winter 1980: Maynard Ferguson Big Band in Brussels
programme.desc: The Brussels Jazz Club was filled to the brim with both musicians and audience members when the Maynard Ferguson Big Band performed there during their Winter Tour of 1980. From the first notes of the cover of Weather Report's “Birdland” that opens the performance to the final notes of “Gonna Fly Now” that closes it, Ferguson gives his young sidemen ample time to shine. The mutual admiration shared by the leader and his sidemen makes this performance a delight to watch.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés, Concha Buika, Rodney Barreto & Dreiser Durruthy Bombale
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne' is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2013 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them were Chucho Valdes and his Afro-Cuban Messengers, the prime example of Latin-inspired jazz music. Together with vocalists Concha Buika and Dreiser Durruthy Bombale, Rodney Barreto on drums, Gaston Joya on double bass, Yaroldy Abreu Robles on congas, and Reinaldo Melian Alvarez on trumpet, the legendary pianist brings the streets of Havana to the festival's stage.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto & Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: Mahler's Symphony No. 6 is a monumental work exploring deep personal tragedy, incorporating a unique, famous "hammer" blows that symbolize the inevitable blows of fate. This symphony's intense emotional power, epic scope, and the composer's eventual wrestling with fate and personal loss make it an unforgettable, profoundly moving experience for audiences.

programme.title: Valery Gergiev
programme.desc: This visually stunning production of Nutcracker is a graceful and timeless adventure on a grand scale. From the lovely Waltz of the Flowers to the crystalline beauty of the stunning Snowflake Waltz, each scene is more breathtaking than the last, bringing to life all the well-known and beloved characters with fresh sparkle and compelling originality. It is Christmas Eve and we are brought to a party at which Drosselmeyer gives young Clara a nutcracker doll - beginning a night that includes a magically growing Christmas tree, a midnight battle of toy soldiers at which the Nutcracker defeats the villainous Mouse King and his army of mice, and a headlong pas de deux in which Clara and Hans-Peter meet and celebrate their triumph before being enveloped in a magical snowstorm. Act II whisks the young pair off to the Kingdom of the Sweets, where they are entertained by the Sugar Plum Fairy with her handsome Prince and her glittering court in a series of dazzling dances. Under the direction of Andreas Morell, Valery Gergiev conducts the Mariinsky Orchestra and Choir. Soloists are Mikhail Makarov, lldar Abdrazakov, Anna Markarova, Sergei Skorokhodov, Timur Abdikeyev, Vladislav Sulimasky. This production was recorded at the Mariinsky Theatre in 2012.

programme.title: Les Dissonances
programme.sub-title: Mozart - String Quartet No. 19 in C major, K. 465
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances' string quartet – consisting of David Grimal (violin), Hans Peter Hofmann (violin), David Gaillard (viola), and Xavier Phillips (cello) – performs Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's String Quartet No. 19 in C major, K. 465, ‘Dissonance' (Op. 10 No. 6). The String Quartet is the last in the set of six quartets that were dedicated to Joseph Haydn. Written between 1782 and 1785, these are also known as the Haydn Quartets (Op. 10). String Quartet No. 19 is remarkable for its slow, dissonant introduction, giving the piece its nickname. This ominous passage suddenly gives way to the bright Allegro in C major. This performance was recorded at Opéra Comique in Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: amarcordplus & Sebastian Heindl
programme.sub-title: Baroque choral music by Bach, Schütz et al.
programme.desc: Five-strong vocal ensemble amarcord is joined by an extra alto and two soprano voices for this unusual concert at Leipzig's St. Thomas Church. As amarcordplus, the ensemble presents a program focused on the city of Leipzig, which includes sacred madrigals by Johann Hermann Schein, motets from Heinrich Schütz's collection Geistliche Chor-Music, as well as two motets by the most famous Thomaskantor: Johann Sebastian Bach. Moreover, various sacred works by lesser-known contemporaries Philipp Heinrich Erlebach and mononymous composer Liebhold are performed, in addition to compositions by other members of the Bach family, including Johann Michael Bach and Johann Christoph Bach. This performance was recorded on May 1, 2020.

programme.title: Florian Boesch, Iwona Sobotka, Robert Murray & Anna Stephany
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) and Chorus in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. The soloists are Iwona Sobotka (soprano), Anna Stephany (mezzo-soprano), Robert Murray (tenor), and Florian Boesch (baritone). Engineered with unmatched symphonic finesse, Beethoven set aside ruminations on fate and heroism to compose his utterly musical and wholly satisfying Ninth Symphony. It is a monumental work, renowned for its innovative use of a chorus and vocal soloists in the final movement, singing a setting of Friedrich Schiller's poem "Ode to Joy". Premiered in 1824, it remains one of the most performed and recognizable pieces of classical music. This performance was recorded at Barbican Hall in London, on February 16, 2020.

programme.title: David Grimal & Les Dissonances
programme.desc: Les Dissonances is a collective of artists founded by violinist David Grimal in 2004. The conductorless ensemble consists of musicians from the most prestigious European orchestras, international soloists, and young talents. In this performance, Les Dissonances play Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Violin Concerto No. 5 in A major, K. 219, also known as the ‘Turkish Concerto'. Leading violinist Grimal features as the soloist. With the exception of the first violin concerto, Mozart composed his other four violin concertos in 1775 at a time when he was concertmaster at the Salzburg court. It is the third and final movement that gives Concerto No. 5 its nickname, the ‘Turkish Concerto'. This movement features a striking middle section of ‘Turkish music', which the composer achieves not only by changing the meter, and the mode to minor, but also by letting the cellos and basses play col legno - creating a percussive sound with the wood of their bow. This performance was recorded at Cité de la Musique, France, in 2014.

programme.title: Ana María Paño-Osorio & Philharmonie de Paris
programme.sub-title: Sinfonía por el Perú from Philharmonie de Paris
programme.desc: Superstar tenor Juan Diego Flórez brings to life the most iconic roles of the bel canto repertoire, joined by the vibrant young musicians of Sinfonía por el Perú, led by the celebrated conductor Ana María Patiño-Osorio! Embark on a lyrical adventure with them, from the powerful drama of Bellini's I Capuleti e I Montecchi and the majestic Jerusalem by Verdi, to the boisterous and spirited cancan of Offenbach's operetta Orpheus in the Underworld. Sinfonía por el Perú is a nonprofit organization founded by Juan Diego Flórez, with a mission to inspire social change through collective music education. Since its inception in 2011, over six thousand young Peruvians have embraced the opportunity to play an instrument or sing in a choir. Students from the program have graced the world's most prestigious stages, from Salzburg to Gstaad, including the Lucerne Festival, and they accompany Juan Diego Flórez for this concert.

programme.title: John Denver
programme.sub-title: Rocky Mountain High: Live In Japan
programme.desc: Arguably one of the most beloved American performers of the 20th century, John Denver had a career that saw him sell over 40 million albums worldwide while winning numerous awards, including 2 Grammy Awards, 3 AMA's, 1 Emmy and 2 CMA's. "Rocky Mountain High: Live In Japan" is a 1981 concert from his 7-show tour of Japan and features a wonderful selection of hits from his career, including 4 of his 5 #1 hits: "Annie's Song", "Calypso", "Sunshine On My Shoulders" & "Thank God I'm A Country Boy".

programme.title: John Mellencamp
programme.desc: John Mellencamp's career in music, spanning more than 42 years, has seen him transition from pop star to one of the most highly regarded songwriters of a generation. Filmed at the landmark Chicago Theatre, just 250 miles away from his upbringing in Indiana, this cinematic concert documentary film captures John Mellencamp reflecting on his career accompanied by self-narration from his highly personal audio diary on his Midwestern upbringing, career and outlook on life as a whole. Meant to be more than just your run of the mill concert film, this intimate performance with full band will fully envelop the viewer into the Mellencamp mindset. “My vision was true, and my heart was too. And there was no end to what I could dream. Life is short, even in its longest days.”

programme.title: El diablo, probablemente (V.O.S.E.)
programme.desc: Charles, un joven de veinte años (Antoine Monnier), aparece muerto en el cementerio parisino de Père-Lachaise. ¿Se trata de un suicidio o de un asesinato? Charles vive entre dos amores, Alberte (Tina Irissari) y Edwige (Laetitia Carcano). Inmerso en conversaciones existenciales con su amigo Michel (Henri de Maublanc), desprecia tanto “la felicidad de la tarjeta de crédito” como el compromiso político no se deja seducir ni por el anarquismo, ni por la militancia ecologista ni por las drogas. Una serie de encuentros casuales le llevan a descubrir en sí mismo el instinto de la autodestrucción.

Dirigida por Jay Roach, cuenta la historia de la guerra del guionista con el gobierno de los EE. UU.

El artista alcanzó una notoriedad asombrosa con sus enigmáticas pinturas de niños abandonados con grandes ojos. La autora era Margaret, su mujer, pero en realidad los firmaba Walter.

programme.title: El duodécimo hombre

programme.title: El velo pintado

programme.title: Me casé con un boludo
programme.desc: Fabián Brando y Florencia Córmik son actores. Él es el más renombrado del país y ella es una completa desconocida. Durante el rodaje de un film inician un fogoso romance que, casi sin noviazgo mediante, termina en casamiento. Durante la luna de miel Florencia se da cuenta de que se casó con un idiota irrecuperable. Cuando Fabián se entera lo que ella piensa de él, idea un plan que sólo podrá llevar a cabo con la ayuda del guionista de sus películas más exitosas.

programme.title: I Am Not a Serial Killer

programme.title: Mejor otro día
programme.desc: Víspera de año Nuevo. En la azotea de un rascacielos de Londres coinciden Martin, Maureen, Jess y JJ para poner fin a su vida. En lugar de saltar, los extraños hacen un pacto para seguir con vida hasta el día de San Valentín. Y así, en el día que todo debía terminar, nace una amistad que los lleva a superar todos los obstáculos juntos. Sus aventuras son emocionantes, impredecibles y una auténtica afirmación de la vida.

programme.title: Sobre ruedas
programme.desc: Jocelyn es un hombre de negocios exitoso, ligón y un mentiroso compulsivo. Cansado de sí mismo se encuentra, a pesar de todo, seduciendo a una joven y bonita mujer haciéndose pasar por un discapacitado. Pero todo cambia el día en que ésta le presenta a su hermana en una silla de ruedas.

Se trata de Tony, un hijo que tuvo 20 años atrás y que abandonó al no poder hacerse cargo de él. A pesar de estar de estar casado y con una familia distinta, Vince se lleva a Tony a casa...

programme.title: Mi querido dictador

programme.title: Kaplan

programme.title: Hincame el Diente

programme.title: Magnolias de Acero
